actions.text: Received in the Senate and Read twice and referred to the Committee on Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs.
Motion to reconsider laid on the table Agreed to without objection.
On motion to suspend the rules and pass the bill Agreed to by voice vote.
Passed/agreed to in House: On motion to suspend the rules and pass the bill Agreed to by voice vote.
Considered as unfinished business. (consideration: CR H5159)

At the conclusion of debate, the chair put the question on the motion to suspend the rules. Mr. Burlison objected to the vote on the grounds that a quorum was not present. Further proceedings on the motion were postponed. The point of no quorum was considered as withdrawn.
DEBATE - The House proceeded with forty minutes of debate on H.R. 7283.
Considered under suspension of the rules. (consideration: CR H4656-4657; text: CR H4656)
Mr. Burlison moved to suspend the rules and pass the bill.
Ordered to be Reported (Amended) by the Yeas and Nays: 44 - 0.
Committee Consideration and Mark-up Session Held
Referred to the House Committee on Oversight and Government Reform.

committees.name: Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs Committee

dimensions.assessment: Affects federal procurement agencies and contractors participating in federal acquisitions.
dimensions.evidence: requires the Federal Acquisition Regulatory Council to adjust certain acquisition-related dollar thresholds for inflation

dimensions.assessment: Adjusts the administrative timing of inflation calculations for purchasing thresholds.
dimensions.evidence: adjust certain acquisition-related dollar thresholds for inflation every three years instead of every five years.

dimensions.assessment: Affects federal purchasing procedures and dollar limits, but states no specific fiscal expenditure amounts.
Amends a single timeframe provision in title 41 of the United States Code.
dimensions.evidence: Section 1908(c)(2) of title 41, United States Code, is amended

dimensions.assessment: Permanent statutory change to the schedule of federal acquisition threshold adjustments.

missing_information: Exact monetary values of the adjusted thresholds at future dates.
importance_detail.rationale: This bill changes the frequency at which the Federal Acquisition Regulatory Council adjusts certain acquisition-related dollar thresholds for inflation, shifting them from every five years to every three years.
